name: getLoomVideo
description:
Reads a Loom video's core metadata and optionally its transcript, comments, AI agent briefs, AI-extracted meeting action items, or attached links in one call via the expand input.
USE WHEN the user asks about a specific Loom video — its title, description, duration, owner, view/comment/reaction counts, what was said in it (pass expand: ["transcript"]), what feedback or comments people left on it (pass expand: ["comments"]), what the AI summarised as key points (pass expand: ["agentBriefs"]), or what follow-up tasks or action items the AI extracted from a meeting recording (pass expand: ["meetingActionItems"]), or which links are attached to it (pass expand: ["links"]).
DO NOT USE to get the downloadable MP4 file — use getLoomVideoDownloadUrl for that. To find a video's ARI first, use listLoomVideos or listLoomVideosSharedWithMe.

cloudId.description: Site UUID or Jira/Confluence URL for this operation's Atlassian site. cloudId is never silently auto-resolved or reused for you — call getAccessibleAtlassianResources ONCE per session, cache the returned cloudId, and pass it explicitly on this and every subsequent call, since most operations need it. `execute` and its read/write/destructive variants strictly require it for cloudId-scoped operations and fail without it. Not needed for cloudId-less operations (e.g. Bitbucket), which ignore this field.

videoAri.description: ARI of the Loom video, formatted as ari:cloud:loom:{siteId}:video/activation/{activationId}/{videoId}. Provide this or videoUrl.

videoUrl.description: Loom share URL for the video, for example https://www.loom.com/share/{videoId}. Used when videoAri is not supplied; a supporting action resolves the URL to an ARI.

expand.description: Optional list of extra data to include in the response, in addition to core metadata. Any subset of "transcript", "comments", "agentBriefs", "meetingActionItems", "links". Omit for core metadata only — nothing is included by default.

transcriptFormat.description: Transcript response shape when expand includes "transcript". Use "text" for summaries, extraction, implementation instructions, and general "what was said" questions. Use "phrases" only when timestamps, speaker/chunk structure, or quote-to-time answers are needed. Use "both" only when the caller explicitly needs both representations.

commentsFirst.description: Maximum number of comments to return when comments is included via expand (1-100).

commentsAfter.description: Pagination cursor to fetch the next page of comments when comments is included via expand.

linksFirst.description: Maximum number of links to return when links is included via expand (1-50).

linksAfter.description: Pagination cursor to fetch the next page of links when links is included via expand.
